## New term

cuboidal epithelial cell equivalent_to epithelial cell and has_characteristic some cuboidal
SubClassOf: columnar cuboidal epithelial cell

## New logical def
squamous epithelial cell equivalent_to epithelial cell and has_characteristic some flattened (PATO:0002254)

## Axiomatization:
- Find all cell types with squamous in name or stated to be squamous in definition and add 'relationship: has_characteristic some flattened (PATO:0002254)
- Find all cell types with cuboidal in name or stated to be squamous in definition and add 'relationship: has_characteristic some cuboidal 

## Documentation
- Extend relations_guide section on cell characteristics to include this
- Add DOSDPs for both patterns under src/patterns
title: Fix design patterns for columnar cuboidal and squamous epithelial cells
